scenes.say: In eighteen twenty-two, a man sold land in a country that did not exist. And hundreds of people sailed there.
scenes.cap: In 1822, a man sold land in a country that DID NOT EXIST. And hundreds of people SAILED there.

scenes.say: His name was Gregor MacGregor, a Scottish soldier back from the wars in South America.
scenes.cap: His name was GREGOR MacGREGOR, a Scottish soldier back from the wars in South America.

scenes.say: In London, he said he was the ruler of Poyais, a rich new nation in Central America.
scenes.cap: In London, he said he was the RULER of POYAIS, a rich new nation in Central America.

scenes.say: He published a guidebook. A capital city. A cathedral. An opera house. Rivers with gold.
scenes.cap: He published a GUIDEBOOK. A capital city. A cathedral. An opera house. Rivers with GOLD.

scenes.say: He sold land, and raised a loan of two hundred thousand pounds in London.
scenes.cap: He sold land, and raised a loan of £200,000 in LONDON.

scenes.say: He even printed his own money. Settlers swapped their real savings for Poyais dollars.
scenes.cap: He even printed his own MONEY. Settlers swapped their real savings for POYAIS DOLLARS.

scenes.say: Then the ships left, with around two hundred and fifty settlers.
scenes.cap: Then the SHIPS left, with around 250 settlers.

scenes.say: When they landed, there was no city. No cathedral. Just jungle.
scenes.cap: When they landed, there was NO CITY. No cathedral. Just JUNGLE.

scenes.say: Disease spread fast. About a hundred and eighty of them died.
scenes.cap: Disease spread fast. About 180 of them DIED.

scenes.say: And MacGregor? He went to France, and tried the same scam again.
scenes.cap: And MacGregor? He went to FRANCE, and tried the same scam AGAIN.

scenes.say: He was never truly punished. He died in Venezuela in eighteen forty-five, honored as a general.
scenes.cap: He was never truly PUNISHED. He died in Venezuela in 1845, honored as a GENERAL.

scenes.say: The country that never existed. Follow Paper Trail for the money stories nobody tells you.
scenes.cap: The country that NEVER EXISTED. Follow PAPER TRAIL for the money stories nobody tells you.

upload.description:
In 1822, Gregor MacGregor convinced London investors and settlers that he ruled 'Poyais', a rich nation in Central America. He sold land, raised a £200,000 loan and printed his own money. The country did not exist. Around 250 settlers sailed there - most of them never came home.

Read more: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Gregor_MacGregor
